# Photography used only in isolated layout previews

`salad-anna-pelzer.jpg` is Anna Pelzer's **Bowl of vegetable salads**, downloaded from [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/bowl-of-vegetable-salads-IGfIGP5ONV0) under the [Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license). The delivered copy is 1200px wide. No source-image crop or edit was performed.

It is used with fabricated restaurant/dish records in local automated screenshots to assess real-photo composition. It is not a photo of any restaurant in FoodLog and is not added to production data or shipped by build.mjs. No production content is copied into these fixtures.
